subject: Trading
title: Bubbles: The Setup
description: A quick win: understand Bubbles: The Setup.

hook.text: Every crash needs a bubble first. Asset prices inflate beyond reason, fueled by greed, cheap money, and a new narrative.

buildup.text: Bubbles follow a pattern: innovation attracts money, then speculation, then mania, then disconnection from reality.

discovery.text: Economist Hyman Minsky mapped five stages: displacement, boom, euphoria, profit-taking, and panic. Always in that order.

twist.text: During a bubble, rational critics get mocked. 'This time is different' becomes the most dangerous phrase in finance.

climax.text: Bubbles are invisible from inside. They're only obvious in hindsight—after the crash reveals the excess.

punchline.text: When everyone agrees prices can only rise, run.

quiz.question: What are Minsky's five stages of a bubble?
